comments.text: Reviewing PR 49 at head 51e6ab87. Scope: re-check upload input contract, multipart framing and limits, fields normalization, error behavior, shared helper refactor, and regression coverage before any patch.

Second review found two additional risks: Base64 input was decoded before its size was bounded, and an invalid MIME type could alter multipart headers. Added pre-decode size validation, strict media MIME validation, default MIME normalization, and regression tests. Focused suite: 113 passed. Full mix quality: passed, including 151 Google Drive tests. Demo format, warnings-as-errors compile, and 21 tests: passed.

title: Refine Google Drive upload PR after second review
